profile.headline: Distributed Systems & Data Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with a proven track record in leading teams and projects.

I have architected and managed distributed, low-latency, mission-critical software systems and micro-services (Python, Go, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, etc) and have migrated services from on-prem data centers to the cloud (AWS, GCP).

My experiences span many areas of tech. I am well-versed in large dataset management, MPP databases (Presto/Trino, Redshift), the AWS stack (EKS, ECS, EC2, EMR, EBS, ELB/ALB, RDS/Aurora, Redshift, VPC, Route53, Lambda, IAM, MSK), data lakes and lake houses (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Parquet), relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), both batch and streaming ETL frameworks (Spark, Spark streaming), and ETL orchestration (Airflow).

I have led and managed teams, in both project and people settings, and have excellent written and oral communication. I am a strong team leader and can unblock and ensure KPIs are met on an expected timeline. I have established best practices in engineering, have led hiring initiatives, and have developed training programs for onboarding new hires.

Finally, as is necessary in tech, I am adaptable and enjoy challenges and learning new technology.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (Innovation)
positions.description:
Founding member of Vestmark's Labs team, created to plan and ship new products on compressed timelines. Served as tech lead for the team's first product, the Reporting module of Vestmark's new multi-tenant "Advisor" SaaS platform, taking it from zero to MVP release.

Built the product end-to-end: a data pipeline and warehouse (PySpark, Kafka/MSK, Debezium, S3, SingleStore), backend APIs in Go, and a Next.js frontend, all deployed on AWS (ECS). Worked cross-functionally to define requirements, resolve ambiguity, and align with executive staff and partner engineering teams. Met directly with customers to shape improvements and roadmap across releases.

Beyond Reporting, I contributed to the architecture and development of other modules in the Advisor suite and built self-service onboarding tooling (Python, Django) that reduced client onboarding from days to minutes.
positions.insights: Skills: golang · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Spark · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Appointed as the project owner across multiple quarterly initiatives. Projects include managing Cogo’s ad-tech platform (generating > 3.5B emails a month) and leading an early stage venture in the auto insurance sector. Developed agenda for weekly and monthly meetings with executive staff. Created and managed work for teams.
- Led migration of services from on-premise to AWS and GCP clouds. Architected cloud services with an eye toward redundancy (multi-AZ and blue/green deployments).
- Architected and managed development of a new, portable email engine for use by incubating companies, employing GCP and commercial ESPs.
- Managed and mentored a team of varying size (up to 10 people).  Regular 1 - 1s, coaching, code review, and feedback.
- Established training program for new engineering hires and developed an Engineering handbook with other SSWEs.

positions.title: Founder - BlockSoup
positions.description:
BlockSoup was a pre-seed startup with a focus on blockchain. It was started and staffed as a venture within the Cogo Labs ecosystem. It lost its funding as apart of Cogo Labs' drastic downsizing in Nov and Dec 22.

- Developed and iterated on the venture roadmap with feedback from potential partners, investors, and Cogo Labs executive staff.
- Architected and established a Lakehouse on AWS containing Ethereum blockchain data. The pipeline was a combination of open-source blockchain software, Kafka, Spark Streaming, and Apache Iceberg deployed on EKS. Backfilled Ethereum data from the genesis block through real-time.
- Deployed and managed Ethereum node using Geth on AWS EKS.

positions.title: Lead Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Regularly report to and interact with executive staff to receive feedback on direction of team and work.
- Lead engineer on a new revenue stream within the incubator involving the on-boarding and evaluation of business intelligence (external datasets) and use of intelligence in vetting of public and private companies for investment.
- Reduced AWS spend by more than $1MM a year through intelligent use of EC2 spot instances, node reservations, ETL code optimization, and data tiering.
- Led transition from legacy Hadoop cluster to modern processing stack of Spark, MPP databases, and object stores.
- Consolidated and funneled alerting channels into OpsGenie and established on-call rotation for the Data Engineering team.	
Managed the transition of email reporting system from intraday batch schedule to Spark streaming.

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead Cogo Labs database team.  Includes the planning, managing, deployment, monitoring, and backups of MySQL and PostgreSQL database hosts. 100+ database instances in production.
- Manage daily ETL pipelines providing vital business intelligence -- AWS, S3, EMR, Presto, Hive, Java, Python

positions.title: Associate Data Warehouse Developer
positions.description:
Some projects at Cogo:

- Automated MySQL failover and switchover.
- Developed APIs in both Apache/MySQL and Flask/Postgres.
- Developed Python scripts to monitor and ease the administration of linux database servers and MySQL administration.
- Administer and troubleshoot Hadoop/Impala environment.
- Added monitoring in the form of Munin plugins.  Easily view things like database instance cpu consumption, replica lag, filesystem growth, and SSD health.
-Nagios alerts

positions.title: Sustaining Engineer
positions.description:
Created Java and JSP hotfixes to relieve customer's issues.
Created distributable fixpacks for main commerce application to be used in customer's production environments.
Developed mobile-friendly commerce site in JSP, HTML, and CSS to serve as a demo site for customers.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Manually executed test plans to check for bugs in LifeYield software.
Designed and implemented automated test suite for LifeYield's Illustrator application.
Worked with QA team to revise and create new test plans as newer iterations of software were developed.
